items.text: Toyota is moving from Mexico to the United States (Texas!). A really big deal. Tariffs at work! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.text: BTC news: Elon Musk's SpaceX moves bitcoin for the first time in six months
items.summary_cn: 马斯克旗下SpaceX三年来首次移动其比特币持仓，加密市场关注；CRCL（Circle/USDC）作为加密基础设施间接受关注。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Great news! I have just been informed that one of the biggest, best, and smartest Retailers in America, Walmart, will be lowering prices, by a lot, at my Administration's request to celebrate our great Country's 250th birthday. Walmart will, in particular, be dropping the price for a pound of ground beef by almost 15%, among many other products. This is a huge deal for the many millions of Americans who, smartly, shop at Walmart, which is a truly patriotic Company who loves the U.S.A. items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump announces Walmart to lower prices for thousands of products at his administration's request: https://justthenews.com/nation/economy/trump-announces-walmart-lower-prices-thousands-products-his-administrations-request
items.summary_cn: 特朗普宣布沃尔玛应其政府请求下调数千种商品价格，视为通胀回落政绩。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk can’t sell a single SpaceX share for a year—and then all the locks crack open at once
items.summary_cn: 报道指出马斯克一年内无法出售任何SpaceX股份，届时所有限售将一次性解锁，对SPCH等SpaceX相关产品构成未来流动性事件风险。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s Net Worth Drops $50 Billion In Latest SpaceX Selloff
items.summary_cn: 马斯克净资产因SpaceX二级市场抛售缩水500亿美元，间接影响SPCH（2倍做多SpaceX ETF）估值锚。

items.text: Breakingviews - Wall Street gets high on Elon Musk's SpaceX supply
items.summary_cn: Reuters Breakingviews评论SpaceX二级份额供给激增，华尔街对马斯克系资产兴趣浓厚，间接利好SPCH。

items.summary_cn: 特朗普发帖欢呼'油价要降'，并转发沙特数十年来最大幅度降油价的报道。
